'''Gears''' ---- '''Gears''' are avatar items that can be bought from the Roblox catalog. In Tower Defense Simulator, '''Gears''' are rarely allowed in the game. However, on a few occasions, some '''Gears''' were once allowed in the game, though their use was limited. Below details all the gears that were once used in the game.
